title: Governance Drift: Reproducibility Package
description: Draft deposit metadata for the Governance Drift v1.6.0 candidate: manuscript source, closed-world detector study, separately implemented no-join baseline, canonical results, and bounded Kubernetes/GitOps laboratories. The primary live campaign retains 538/540 detections with 538/538 exact provisional class-set classifications conditional on detection under a sequential-snapshot laboratory assumption, plus 45/45 exact provisional compound class sets. The candidate adds activation-safe basis-selection probes at B4 (separate from the frozen primary live campaign), admissible temporal-cut tests, transition-inclusive controls, a nine-episode/27-process trace audit with two-poll exact persistence, localhost transport faults, scaling benchmarks, a live multi-Deployment adapter path, and a pending Argo CD/Gatekeeper frozen rerun limited to projected singleton classifications over declared evaluated components. Only configuration and policy use native second-stack surfaces; authorization retains the shared digest adapter, and intent/environment are not evaluated there. These results demonstrate bounded semantic realizability and within-laboratory behavior, not natural occurrence, field prevalence, production effectiveness, equivalence, or production reliability. No v1.6.0 DOI or release tag is claimed until the candidate is frozen and verified.
